records.precondition: A seller turns off sale and review emails; buyers buy and review
records.expected: No sale email while off, one again after switching it back on; a review sends the seller an email only while review emails are on; the buyer is mailed either way

records.name: Buyer gets a confirmation when opening a dispute
records.precondition: A buyer opens a dispute on a delivered item
records.expected: Buyer, seller and staff each get the dispute email written for them

records.name: Colour scheme, security.txt and static files through nginx and TLS
records.precondition: A visitor uses the footer colour-scheme form; scanners ask for security.txt and dotfiles; a browser loads the stylesheet
records.expected: The choice is stored in a Secure, HttpOnly cookie and applies to the next pages, error pages included; security.txt answers with the contact; other dotfiles stay blocked; CSS is gzipped and cached for a year under its hashed URL; HTML is neither

records.name: Upgrade: the go-live migrations on a populated database
records.precondition: All earlier scenarios left their data; the four go-live and three performance migrations are rolled back and applied again, as an upgrade from the previous release would
records.expected: Both directions run cleanly; no row is lost; existing users get both email preferences switched on; the new indexes exist again; the shop keeps serving buyers and staff

records.name: Notification centre: events, badge, open and read all
records.precondition: A new buyer buys with crypto from a seller who turned sale emails off
records.expected: The buyer sees "placed" and "paid" in the list and the header badge; opening an entry marks it read and goes to the order; "mark all as read" clears the badge; the seller gets no sale email but the sale is in the seller list; emails still arrive
evidence: buyer entries: ['Order 5e158eae placed: awaiting payment', 'Order 5e158eae paid']

records.name: The notification list does not depend on the mail server
records.precondition: The mail server is down when support answers a ticket
records.expected: The buyer sees the reply in the notification list at once; the email follows once the mail server is back

records.name: Staff alerts in the notification list of super admins and managers
records.precondition: Forged payment callbacks arrive
records.expected: Super admin and manager see the alert in their list; support, finance and moderator do not

records.name: Live updates endpoint through nginx and TLS
records.precondition: Buyers, another buyer, a guest and staff ask /live about pages while an order is paid and a ticket is answered
records.expected: Guests get 401; the order version changes when the order is paid and matches the version on the page; balance and unread count are current; pages the user may not see have no version; internal staff notes do not change the customer version but a reply does; responses are not cached; polling is limited to 30 a minute

records.name: Seller replies to a review
records.precondition: The buyer from the first scenario reviews the product; its seller answers, edits; another seller tries; a moderator removes the reply
records.expected: The seller is told about the review; the reply shows under the review; the reviewer gets one email and one list entry that links to the review; editing sends nothing; another seller is refused; the moderator can remove it

records.name: FF-03 A payout sent to the gateway whose answer was lost
records.precondition: seller05 has an approved payout; finance sends it through Shkeeper; the gateway accepts it and never answers
records.expected: The payout is not marked failed and not sent again blindly (its outcome is unknown); once the gateway reports the result, the payout is paid and the ledger is debited exactly once

records.name: FR-01 Connection lost while the checkout is being processed; the buyer sends it again
records.precondition: p12-hangup has 40.00 USD; the account row is held by another transaction, the balance checkout is sent and the connection drops after a second while the server waits; then the lock is released
records.expected: Whether the server finished the dropped request or abandoned it, the account ends with exactly one paid order and one debit after the buyer sends the same form again, and the retry shows that order
evidence: hangup: connection dropped after 1.0s while waiting for the account lock; the server finished it: orders [['delivered', '299']], balance 3701
hangup2: connection dropped after 0.0s; the server never processed it: orders [], balance 4000

records.name: FR-02 PHP-FPM restarted while checkouts are being processed
records.precondition: Six p12 buyers with 30.00 USD each send balance checkouts; their account rows are held by another transaction so the requests are inside PHP when the app container restarts (SIGTERM)
records.expected: Requests cut off by the restart fail visibly (502/503/504 or a dropped connection); nothing is half-written: no order without its debit and no debit without a paid order; the same form sent again gives exactly one paid order each
